description: Defines data structures, constants, and enums for disk cache block file format, including index headers, cache entries, and LRU data, used in Chromium's disk cache implementation.

classes.name: IndexHeader
classes.description: Header structure for the master index file, containing metadata about the cache index.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Represents the entire index file structure, including header and table.

classes.name: EntryStore
classes.description: Main structure for a cache entry, including key, hash, data pointers, and metadata.

classes.name: RankingsNode
classes.description: Structure holding LRU and modification info for cache entries.
